## Task 1 – The setup check

**In your IDE workspace.** Run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until it reports no failure, and render `index.qmd` once. Then read the four scenarios of the warm-up in the box of Task 1 of `index.qmd`, and fill in their gaps.

[Open the slides at Task 1](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the webR workspace at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If your installation fails, run the cells of the setup check in the slides or in the webR workspace, and carry on there for the rest of the day.

To go further: [SCORE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/score.html) on the AR4DS website.
